$comment: PK (1.6.0): real 3D models (.glb, made in Meshy) for the world's props. Each slot replaces one built-in shape when the graphics preset has props on; a slot with no file keeps the built-in shape. file = under apps/game/public-mobile/; source = PK's raw download (C:\Users\ASUS\Downloads\3D model), shrunk by scripts/models/props.mjs to `tris` triangles and a `tex` px WebP colour map. fit: 'height' scales the model to the built-in shape's height, 'width' to its widest side. tint multiplies the model's colours; sway = the crown moves in the wind; sink = share of the height set into the ground; bake 'vertex' paints the colour map into the vertices (plants: no texture, cut far down); light / sat brighten and saturate baked plants (applied in the game, no rebuild). diorama: false = the slot keeps the built-in shape in the Angkor Cel-Diorama look (PK 1.7.0: the Meshy broadleaf and mango read crumpled at RTS distance). buildings (PK 1.8.0): a building type drawn from PK's own model (shrunk by scripts/models/shrink.mjs to 1024 px WebP, normal map dropped); its front (steps, door) faces +z; fit width = its widest side matches the built-in shape's; the model keeps its own colours (no team colour), damage still darkens it.

dikePalm.en: Sugar palm on the paddy dikes (thnot)

townCentre.source: Royal_hall.glb (PK 1.8.0, his Blender export, 9 682 triangles: a wooden hall on stilts with tiered roofs and a brick terrace with steps at the front)
